data.narrative:
Intramotev is a Series A stage company in the Drones & Autonomous sector that has raised $14.4M to date. The relevant comp universe consists of 8 private companies in drones and autonomous systems, including peers such as Waymo, Wayve, Zipline, Joby Aviation, and Nuro. No public comparables exist in this narrow category.

Given the early-stage nature and nascent market conditions, only the stage-progression method proved applicable. This approach uses total capital raised ($14.4M) as a valuation proxy and applies a 2.0x multiplier typical of Series A to subsequent-stage step-ups, yielding an implied valuation of $29M. A peer-median approach could not be reliably applied due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage datapoints within the narrow Drones & Autonomous segment—only one adjacent-stage comparable was identified against a required threshold of three or more—creating unacceptable selection bias.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $24M to $33M, with a median point of $29M. This range reflects conservative to moderate expansion from the capital-raised baseline. Key uncertainties include the lack of revenue or unit economics data, absence of comparable-company multiples in the immediate peer set, and the nascent regulatory environment for autonomous systems. Investors should treat this as an indicative range pending disclosure of operational metrics and near-term funding milestones.
